renderCustomMessageTemplate() calls Handlebars.compile() on `templateSource`, which is the full template text pasted in by an attorney (not just merge data), then executes the compiled template. This is reachable from app/routes/app.messages._index.tsx's composeMessageFromCustomTemplate(). Compiling attacker-influenced template source (rather than only interpolating data into a fixed, trusted template, as renderStandardMessageTemplate() does with STANDARD_TEMPLATES) is a server-side template injection surface — Handlebars templates can invoke helpers and traverse object/prototype chains, and untrusted template sources have historically been used to achieve remote code execution against Handlebars.
